Karthik Rasamsetti - Consolidated Knowledge
Base
Professional Summary
Karthik is a QA Automation Engineer with about 3+ years of experience. He works at Feuji and
contributes across QA Automation, Performance Engineering, API testing, and AI-driven QA
solutions. He is actively building AI agents for the QA domain and regularly experiments with
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangGraph, FastAPI, and Hugging Face.
Core Skills
Automation: Playwright, Selenium, WebDriverIO, Karate, TestNG, Rest Assured. Languages: Java,
JavaScript, Python. Performance: K6, WebLOAD, Prometheus, Grafana. Backend: Spring Boot,
FastAPI. Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, KùzuDB. CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, TeamCity.
AI: LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, RAG.
Projects

deployment persistence concerns. 3. AI SQL Assistant using Hugging Face. 4. Resume screening,
interview automation and HR AI workflows. 5. Test case generation from Jira user stories using AI
agents. 6. Performance testing using K6/WebLOAD.
Technical Experience
Worked on API automation, UI automation, Playwright framework design, Extent/Allure reporting,
GitHub Actions, Docker, authentication, PostgreSQL restoration, Java and Python development,
performance engineering, API rate limiting validation, and production troubleshooting.
Interview Knowledge
Frequently prepares for and discusses QA Automation interviews including Selenium, Playwright,

performance testing.
